finding.nature_justification: Patch §1.3 ordered check. Local first: N+1 foreach+ToListAsync pattern is observable inside one class/method (ScheduleService.Delete case 2 creator branch, lines 804-814). But the per-item query targets ScheduleUserEntity (a typed-entity different from ScheduleEntity) via the ISqlSugarRepository<ScheduleEntity>.AsSugarClient() interface — i.e. the pattern crosses a direct typed-entity dependency through a 1-layer interface method (AsSugarClient → Queryable<T>). Per §1.3 Regional = 'direct interface/dependency/inheritance relationship, 1-layer crossable via interface signature/constructor/inheritance chain', this matches. Ruled out Systemic because no cross-.csproj or Service↔Repository↔Provider layer crossing is required to falsify the Claim.
finding.claim: ScheduleService.Delete (line 744) case 2 creator branch (lines 804-814) executes an N+1 query shape: a single 'dataList' fetch at lines 800-802 is followed by 'foreach (var item in dataList)' (line 807) whose body issues 'await _repository.AsSugarClient().Queryable<ScheduleUserEntity>().Where(...).ToListAsync()' at lines 809-811, producing 1 + N independent SQL round-trips where N = dataList.Count. Falsifiable by: (a) reading lines 807-811 to see the foreach+per-item ToListAsync; (b) observing that the sibling else branch (lines 815-826) batches the same ScheduleUserEntity fetch at lines 817-819 outside the foreach, proving the N+1 shape is not forced by API constraints.

actions.purpose: Read Delete method case 2 (lines 759-829) to confirm N+1 foreach + per-item Queryable<ScheduleUserEntity>.ToListAsync shape at lines 807-811, and contrast with the batched else branch at lines 815-826.

five_tuple.claim: ScheduleService.Delete case 2 creator branch (lines 804-814) executes an N+1 query shape: 1 fetch of dataList (lines 800-802) followed by N independent per-item ToListAsync against ScheduleUserEntity (lines 809-811).
five_tuple.evidence: Level 1 verbatim code at file:line 800-802 (dataList source query), 804 (branch predicate), 807-811 (foreach + per-item Queryable<ScheduleUserEntity>.ToListAsync). Contrast: the sibling else branch (lines 815-826) batches the same query (lines 817-819) outside the foreach, demonstrating the N+1 shape in the creator branch is not API-forced.
five_tuple.impact: Claim 成立 → scheduleLogList 累积过程中对每条 dataList 都触发一次独立 SQL，命中 Executor-Brief v4 硬门 2 (性能)：N+1/批量类 Claim 即使形态确证，若缺运行时数据量级证据，Decision 不得为 GO；同时 Patch §3 Decision 必须唯一且 Confidence 边界决定升级路径. Claim 不成立 → 即便 fetch 模式成立，形态仅是 potential；若运行期 dataList.Count=1 (典型单日程删除)，则无性能影响，不构成缺陷.

final.stop_reason: §2.3 五判据全部满足 (Claim 可证伪 [FQ-1/2/3=✓, 不命中 N1-N5]/ Evidence 可回溯 [file:line 800-802, 804, 807-811, 817-819]/ Impact 链完整 [成立/不成立分述]/ Decision 唯一 [单值 NEED_EVIDENCE]/ Confidence=High) → STOP-1 命中 → Decision Re-entry → Executor-Brief v4 硬门 2 (N+1/批量类 Claim 即使形态确证，缺运行时数据量级证据 → 不得为 GO，应为 NEED_EVIDENCE). v4 三门封闭：NEED_EVIDENCE 为第三独立态，既不滑入 GO，也不压成 STOP；非 ESCALATE (按 §4.0，ESCALATE 非第四 Decision，本 Finding 未触发 STOP-5).
